headline: TI authors evaluate machine-learning techniques for analog waveform prediction
fact: A Texas Instruments ISQED 2023 paper evaluates a machine-learning behavioral-model method for time-domain waveform prediction using feature extraction, waveform segmentation, and circuit partitioning. In an operational-amplifier proof of concept, the authors report an average output-prediction signal-to-noise ratio of 32 dB. The result is an evaluated proof of concept, not evidence of production deployment.

sources.title: ISQED 2023 program
sources.summary: The official program identifies the TI authors and dates the waveform-prediction paper to April 6, 2023.

sources.title: Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques for Time Domain Waveform Prediction in Analog and Mixed Signal IC Verification
sources.summary: The IEEE record describes the ML behavioral-model method, operational-amplifier proof of concept, and reported 32 dB average output-prediction SNR.
